structured.answer: With 300 ₪ a month, taking it out after 4 years leaves about 15,162 ₪ (14,400 of it is what I put in), and after 8 years about 34,412 ₪, with no tax. That's the employee mode with the employer part set to 0, because the self-employed button wouldn't switch.

findings.what: The עצמאים button doesn't respond, so a self-employed person can't get their own numbers
The default numbers include 900 ₪ a month from an employer, and the first big result (52,334) is wrong for a self-employed person, but it sticks in your head

findings.what: The deposit is only set as a % of gross salary, not as a shekel amount per month

Bar colours (grey/dark grey/teal/pink stripes) aren't explained next to the bars
